params.prompt: Full-body front-view color character illustration based on the attached reference photos of the real Korean MMA fighter Seo Jin-soo, stylized as a grounded anime character while keeping his real face, facial hair and build recognizable. He stands relaxed but perfectly balanced with his weight even on both feet, arms hanging loosely at his sides, hands half open, chin level, a relaxed, easygoing, slightly amused face with a closed mouth. He is a 36-year-old Korean man, a former professional MMA bantamweight who now runs his own MMA gym in Seoul: 170 cm, about 7.3 heads tall with realistic proportions, a lean, wiry fighter build with solid rounded shoulders, a thick neck, a narrow waist and defined but not bulky arms. Light warm skin. A long oval face with defined cheekbones and a firm jaw, narrow single-lidded eyes, straight dark eyebrows, a straight nose; a black moustache and a short goatee with light stubble along the jaw. His hair is his current style: straight black hair grown to shoulder length, loosely tucked behind his ears, a few strands falling by the cheeks. Outfit: a plain muted olive-khaki short-sleeved gym t-shirt (#67684F), black compression arm sleeves on both arms from under the t-shirt sleeves down to the wrists (#262628), plain black loose training pants (#2A2A2C) without stripes, bare feet. Plain unbranded clothing. Colors: light warm skin with mauve shadows, black hair and beard, the muted olive-khaki t-shirt as the main tone with the black arm sleeves and pants; no orange anywhere. Plain warm off-white paper background (#F4EFE6) with a soft grounding shadow under the feet, whole body visible from hair to soles. Muted cinematic anime cel shading, like a still from a grounded theatrical anime film: flat colors with one crisp shadow tone (a second darker tone only under the chin and beneath the brow), skin shadows in soft mauve-brown, shadows on white cloth in cool blue-grey, soft pink flush on cheeks, nose tip, ears and knuckles. Bold, slightly rough warm near-black outlines (#1A1417), thick on the silhouette and thin inside. Low-to-medium saturation, no gradients on the character, no glossy highlights, no rim-light glow, no eye sparkle, very subtle paper grain. Avoid: big shiny anime eyes, eye highlights, spiky anime hair, glossy skin, elongated 8-9-head fashion proportions, bodybuilder muscles, visible tattoos, scars, bandages, gloves on the hands, a headband, a cap, a man bun, dyed or bleached hair, a championship belt, cigarettes, smoking, alcohol, brand logos, any readable text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks or signatures.
